verdict.rationale: OpenCode's own MCP docs say you can add external tools through the Model Context Protocol, and that both local and remote MCP servers are supported. That directly delivers plugging MCP servers in as a tool source. missing for 10: detailed evidence of configuration, auth and tool-management options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can add external tools to OpenCode using the _Model Context Protocol_, or MCP. OpenCode supports both local and remote servers.
